content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I didn't start a new thread because this discussion was already very informative. I'm new to the [product_name] family and I'm trying to set up communication with an ATV 630, but currently nothing seems to be working. Has anyone configured a Modbus connection panel? The use case is for a demo to control start, stop, and RPM.
Can you explain what you mean by a Modbus connection panel?

Ah, are you referring to the connection table of the Modbus setup in the [product_name] software? Are you certain that the Unit-ID value of 255 is correct? By the way, [product_name] applies an offset of +1 to Modbus addresses.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to configure Modbus TCP communication between a [product_name] device and an ATV 630 for demo purposes, specifically for start, stop, and RPM control, but their setup isn't working yet. The discussion focuses on Modbus address settings and Unit-ID configuration in the [product_name] software. The thread highlights that users unfamiliar with [product_name] and its Modbus integration face a learning curve, especially when working with third-party equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a simple, straightforward way to set up Modbus TCP communication between their [product_name] device and the ATV 630, along with helpful guidance or tools to set correct parameters like Unit-ID and address offset.
